press_references.value: Agent Skills: The AI Operating System for Sales Managers

product_launches.description: Ambition launched Agent Skills, a configurable library of AI workflows that helps sales organizations automate coaching preparation, pipeline inspection, forecasting, performance reviews, and related management tasks.

press_references.value: Ambition Unveils a Reimagined, Agentic Revenue Execution Platform for the AI Era

product_launches.description: Ambition announced an early access launch of its rebuilt, agentic revenue execution platform, featuring a new Performance Graph, Ambition Agent, and configurable AI Skills to support real-time revenue execution for sales organizations.

about_short_description.short_description: Ambition is an enterprise software company building the world's first modern sales management platform. Endorsed by Harvard Business Review.

product.name: Ambition Revenue Execution System
product.description: A cloud-based platform that combines sales coaching, performance data, pipeline insights, and seller activation to help revenue teams execute strategy and manage performance.

product.name: Coaching Orchestration
product.description: Software for structuring and automating sales coaching through recurring 1:1 cadences, coaching programs, centralized documentation, and manager workflows.

product.name: Performance Intelligence
product.description: Analytics and AI capabilities that combine revenue, activity, pipeline, and performance data to identify risks, trends, skill gaps, and recommended management actions.

product.name: Sales Activation
product.description: Tools that reinforce target seller behaviors through goals, leaderboards, scorecards, competitions, recognition, and visibility into activity and performance.

product.name: Ambition Integrations
product.description: Connections between Ambition and CRM, sales-engagement, conversation-intelligence, collaboration, and enablement systems to provide contextual performance and coaching data.

product.name: Implementation and Customer Success Services
product.description: Enterprise services covering implementation planning, data and integration readiness, training, technical support, strategic advisory, and outcome-based success planning.
